failure_summary.description: Agents ignored new constraints or failed to retrieve and update the latest suitable cached results, despite explicit incremental-update rules.
Agents omitted independently runnable requested work or failed to save results, including during clarification turns.
Agents mis-mapped locations or rating criteria, supplied an incomplete range, or used unnecessary date code that failed at runtime.

patch.reasoning: The recurring cache, persistence, and independent-domain failures are already directly covered by the skill, as are state-versus-city mapping, date-tool use, and numeric rating ranges. Repeating those instructions would not address the observed non-adherence; rating-phrase edge cases also overlap with previously rejected edits. No new generalizable gap warrants a patch.
